translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Kamae Samuel, osheki rowashiretakotakari maawoeni Israel-paeni, ikiteetakeri inampiki Ramá-ki. Ikanta Saúl romishtowa-wetakawo inampiki sheri-piyaari-paeni eejatzi yotako-shire-tantatsiri.
Piyotee-yakani Filistia-jatzi, pokaeyanakini ipanko-sheta-teeyapaakani Sunem-ki rowayiritantya. Imatakiro Saúl rirori, ipiyotakiri Israel-paeni, panko-sheta-teeyakani Gilboa-ki.
Ikanta Saúl iñaakiro ipanko-sheta Filistia-jatzi, antawo ithaawanaki, itzinka-shiryaanakiri.
Ikowakowi-takari Tajorentsi, tee rakiri, tee imishitakaaneeri. Tee iyotakaaneeri Urim eejatzi kamantan-taniri.
Ikantakiri Saúl romperatanewo: “Pamini sheri-piyaawo, niyaata-shiteroota nojampitero.” Ikantanakiri rompera-tanewo: “Eenitatsi apaani tsinani poñaachari Endor-ki, sheri-piyaawo roori.”

Ikithaa-tanaka Saúl otsipa kithaa-rentsi eero iyotantawakari. Itsipata-nakari apite atziri. Jatanaki rareetyaawo iroka tsinani. Ikantapaakiro: “Nokoyi pinkaema-shireenari nokantakimiri. Pamakinari ishire atziri nokoyiri naaka.”
Okantanaki tsinani: “Piyotakiro eeroka rantakiri Saúl, romishitowakiri sheri-piyaari-paeni eejatzi yotako-shire-tantatsiri. ¿Iitaka piñaa-shirinka-tanari, rooma pikoyi rowamahaetina?”
Ikanta-nakiro: “Riitaki yotatsi Tajorentsi eero pashironkaa-waeta, tekatsi owajanki-terimi.”
Kowanaki tsinani, okantziri: “¿Iitaka pikoyiri nokaemakotimiri?” Ikantanakiro Saúl: “Nokoyi pikaemako-tinari Samuel-ni.”
Oñaatziiri tsinani irika Samuel-ni, antawo okaemanaki. Okantakiri Saúl: “¿Iitaka pamatawi-tantanari? Eeroka-taki Saúl.”
Ikantaki pinkathari: “Eero pithaawa-kaawo, ¿iitaka piñaakiri?” Okantzi tsinani: “Noñaaki osheki tajorentsi-witachari rateetziro jenoki.”
Ikantzi Saúl: “¿Jempe ikanta-waetaka?” Okantzi roori: “Antariki rini, ikithaatawo owewiryaakoro.” Riyotanaki Saúl riitaki Samuel, rotziwerowanaka ipinkatha-tanakiri.

Ñaawaetanaki Samuel-ni, ikantziri: “¿Iitaka poñaa-shirenkan-tanari pikaema-kaantana?” Ikantziri Saúl: “Antawo okantzimo-shiryaakina, rowayiri-mintha-takina Filistia-jatzi. Rookawen-takina Tajorentsi, tee rakina nokowako-witari, tee romishimpyaana eejatzi. Nokanta-witari kamantantaniri, tekatsi ikantinari. Rootaki nokaeman-tzimiri eeroka pikantina iitarika nanteri.”
Ikantzi Samuel: “¿Iitaka pojampi-tantanari naaka? Tema rookawen-tanakimira Tajorentsi, ikija-neentanakimi.
Imatakimi Tajorentsi okaatzi ikamanta-kinari naaka jempe ikantemi. Rookakahaemiro pipinkathari-witaha, ipinkathari-takahaeri David, pitsipaminthari.
Tema tee pikemijantziri ikanta-witakimiri, tee pithonkiri Amalec-jatzi. Rootaki piñaanta-kawori tee rakaemi Tajorentsi.

Ikowaki Tajorentsi ithonkiri Filistia-jatzi irika Israel-paeni. Ari itsipataakimi eeroka eejatzi. Okiteji-tamaneerika pitsipa-teena naaka eejatzi pitomi-paeni. Ishinetakiri Tajorentsi Filistia-jatzi itsinampaeteri rowayirite Israel-paeni.”
Antawo ithaawanaki Saúl, ikemakirira Samuel-ni. Oshipetashiryaapaakiri, tyaanaki jaawiki, omaryaa-penthaakii-tapaaka. Apaani kitejeri eejatzi apaani tsireniri tee rowaeya.
Okanta oñaakiri tsinani ithaawanaki Saúl, opokashi-tapaakiri, okantziri: “Nomatakimiro pikowako-takinari. Noshinewentakimi.
Nokoyi powawakya eepichokiini, pishintsitantaneeyaari, piyaa-tantaneeyaari.”
Tee ikowawitya Saúl royaa. Ishintsitashitakari inampina-paeni eejatzi tsinani, roojatzi ikowantanakari royaa. Piriintanaa, jeekanee omaamentoki.
Owamaaki tsinani opira, owetsikaki pan kaari shineyatsini.
Aanakiniri Saúl rowanawo. Ari rowaeyakani itsipatakari inampina-paeni. Ikanta ikaatakiro rowaka, katziyanaka, jateeyaneeni tsireniriki.

footnotes.text: 28.6 Kantakotachari jaka “Urim”, rootaki mapiki poreryaatatsiri, iyotanteetari paerani.
